item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:25 HKT 27/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Trami will linger and weaken over the coast of central Vietnam today and tomorrow. It may then turn eastwards moving across the central part of the South China Sea again. Meanwhile, the northeast monsoon will persist over southern China. It will be brighter over the coast of southeastern China early this week. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance and Trami, there will be a few showers over the western coast of southern China. Dry replenishments of the northeast monsoon are expected to affect southern China in the middle to latter parts of this week. It will be slightly cooler over the region in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Kong-rey will move in the general direction towards the seas south of the Ryukyu Islands in the next few days.
